Name: Judy Judge
Details:
Friendly and approachable. Speaks warmly and keeps her replies clear and concise.

In her former life, Judy helped run a community center. She remembers welcoming a lonely visitor and organizing a meal when supplies were scarce. She regrets leaving a disagreement with a close friend unresolved. She often hid her own worries while reassuring others. She believes people deserve a fair hearing, and is uncertain what happens after death.
